utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting for book club this week, or did the time change?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any time change, so I think we’re still on for this week.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. What day and time are we meeting again?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s that mystery one, unless they changed it and I missed the memo.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could be either way — I can grab my copy and we’ll figure it out at the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking something a little lighter this month, which feels nice for a change.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That does sound nice, though I hope they picked something easy to get a copy of. I’d hate to be hunting around at the last minute.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Me too—last month I nearly had to beg three neighbors for a copy. I’ll ask around and see if anyone knows what they chose.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what are you planning for it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m thinking we could meet at the community room by the library, maybe next Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great to me—next Thursday evening in the community room works well. I can help spread the word or bring a few snacks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’d love to spread the word about book club—want me to invite a few neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be kind of you, Quinn. A few neighbors would be nice.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to a few folks on the block and see who’s interested. I’ll let you know who wants to come!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’ve got the book club details organized if you want them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, send them over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we’re meeting Thursday at 7 on my porch, and this month’s book is "The Midnight Library."

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the book club—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Could you check when the next meeting is and whether we’re picking a new book?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check both details for you and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds lovely — I just need to check the school pickup schedule first. What day are you thinking for book club?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wednesday evening would work well for me, but I’m happy to adjust if pickup makes another day easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wednesday evening could work if I can line up pickup, so let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits about the book club so far—what’s it like?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s pretty relaxed and friendly—mostly a mix of people swapping thoughts on the book and chatting a bit after. You should come by sometime; I think you’d fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely—I'd be happy to come by sometime. Just let me know which book you’re reading next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club? I’m a little swamped, but I’m in if you keep me posted on the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, can you confirm you’re still okay with that if I send the details later?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still good with that—send them over when you can and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m thinking I might stop by the book club this week. What are they reading?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—book club. I think it’s something about a mystery this week, but I’d better check so I don’t steer you wrong.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries—just let me know when you check. I’m happy to read whatever they pick.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plan to everyone and make sure we stay on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and bring what we need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll spread the word and keep everyone updated on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club picked a new read this month—what did you think of it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t read the new one yet, but I’m curious what everyone thinks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Same here—I’m hoping it’s a good one. If you hear any early opinions, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m still a little foggy on the details, but I’m happy to join in. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’m glad you’re in — we’re reading "The Midnight Library" this time. We’ll meet at my place next Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, perfect — I’ll put that on my calendar so I don’t forget. Thanks, Vik; I’ll see you next Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club? Right — when’s the next meeting again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Next Tuesday at 7 in the community room. If you want, I can send the reminder text too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please send the reminder text — I’ll probably forget otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli—if the book club needs any extra chairs, a projector, or even a folding table, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. Let’s keep it simple for now and I’ll let you know if we need anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just give me a holler if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Quinn — I’m happy to help with the book club. What are you thinking for the next read?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect — I’d love to invite everyone to read something lively and easy to discuss. Maybe we can pick a page-turner and I’ll start spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great — let’s go with a page-turner that’s easy to chat about. If you pick one, I’ll help get the word out too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I’m glad we’re finally chatting about the book club—how’s it been going on your end?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s been going well—mostly meeting at the community center on Maple, right near the front desk. I’ve been keeping track of the dates, too, if you want them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks—having the dates would help me keep up. And Maple near the front desk is easy enough for me to remember.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Cleo — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What book are we thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thank you, Rosa! I was thinking we could start with something cozy and easy to discuss — maybe a mystery or a good feel-good novel.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect — cozy and easy to discuss is just right. If you’d like, I can suggest a few titles and we can pick one together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the book club so far—what’s it like?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s pretty relaxed—mostly we pick a book, read at our own pace, then meet up and talk about it. Are you thinking of joining?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I might—sounds like my kind of pace. What book are you all reading next?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the book and time, and I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send over the book and time tonight. Thanks, Bo!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll look out for it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still good for the book club meeting next week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still good for the meeting next week.
